knowledge_point.title: Calculating the Area of a Triangle

question.:question/problem:
![](images/1f/1f19be54313a6cc165ea4de47a3e321a83bc90a13362bf03b6760564c04b75e1.png)

Find the area of $△ABC$. Round your answer to two decimal places.

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The formula for the area of the triangle is 

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}ac\operatorname{sin}⁡B,
$$

where $∠B$ is between the sides of lengths $a$ and $c.$ 

Here, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}c & =AB=23, \\ a & =BC=47, \\ m∠B & ={58}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since 

$$
\operatorname{sin}⁡{58}^{∘}=0.848\,048,
$$

rounded to six decimal places,  we calculate the area as follows:
 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 47\cdot 23\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{58}^{∘} \\  & =540.5\cdot (0.848\,048) \\  & ≈458.37,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to two decimal places.
